MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "General repair epoxy feels like a plausible next purchase alongside my recent fastening and mounting supplies because it could help with another household repair.",
    "Both J-B Weld Original and Gorilla epoxy fit that repair interest, although I would choose J-B Weld this time rather than buy two adhesives for the same need."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Layout fluid, precision tweezers, calipers and electrical connectors require specific projects I do not currently have; buying nails and screws does not give me a reason to use those tools.",
    "My disposable medicine cups do not imply a need for glass measuring cylinders, and my wood screws do not imply a need for locking nuts without matching bolts.",
    "Adhesive hooks and plastic repair putty would need their own immediate purpose; my recent mounting purchases do not mean I need every mounting or repair option."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat workshop and repair supplies as interchangeable, even when they serve very different tasks.",
    "Shared functions such as measuring, fastening or repairing seem to count too heavily without considering what I would actually measure, fasten or repair."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of framing nails and wood screws suggest a more concrete interest in construction and mounting work than in precision metalworking or electronics repair.",
    "I choose supplies when they meet a current need: compatible fasteners matter, and a second adhesive is unnecessary once I have selected one."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my practical repair interests but stretch them into specialized tasks that my recent choices do not support."
}
